name: Verdensbrief — de største sakene og hvordan de møter Norge
_purpose: Daily. Scan the major news outlets (NYT, BBC, Guardian, CNN, Washington Post, Bloomberg, DW, NPR, PBS, Al Jazeera, France 24, Politico Defense) for the biggest issues of the day -- biggest meaning the stories most of them converge on and the ones with the largest consequence -- and say concretely how each one faces Norway. Asked for by Jared 2026-10-06.
_window_hours_note: 48 hours so a story that broke late yesterday and is still the biggest today is in the window; the template is told to lead on what is new.
_max_items_note: 40 -> 30 on 2026-10-06: with the item index and descriptive paragraphs in two languages, 40 items overran even a 32000-token output budget and the JSON truncated on every model. Still larger than the digest: the point is to see the same story from several outlets, so convergence can be measured rather than guessed.
